data.short_description: ThirdLove is expanding its brick-and-mortar presence with a new store at Aventura Mall, listed as "Coming Soon" on the mall's upper level. The brand, which once operated only online, has been building a retail footprint in recent years. No opening date has been announced.

Burrito Bear will take over the former Wild Ginger space in Lower Manhattan, bringing Denver-style breakfast burritos with green chili to NYC. The fast-casual concept is currently under construction and plans to debut this fall.

Convict Coffee is preparing to open its third Denver-area shop, planned for 2260 E. Colfax Avenue according to a city filing. The company, founded to support recidivism-reduction efforts, has not announced an official opening date.

data.short_description: Pepper Lunch, a DIY Teppanyaki concept, is set to open at BLVD Las Vegas as part of a 20-store deal with the Carl L. Karcher Group. The opening was confirmed by CLK's Executive Vice President, Domenic Bonacci.

data.status: Opening date has not been announced

Shake Shack will open a new Oakville location as part of a three-location Ontario expansion. It is one of three new Ontario locations slated to open over the next year.
Shake Shack will open a new Burlington location, part of its expansion across Ontario. The location is expected to open in 2026 alongside the Oakville site.

data.location: 3275 Wonderland Rd S, London, ON N6L 0E3, Canada
data.short_description: Shake Shack's London location will be the first in Ontario to offer a drive-thru and is slated to open in 2027. It will feature signature items made with 100% premium Canadian ingredients.

Madison on Park will temporarily close on September 7, 2026, for a top-to-bottom renovation and concept overhaul led by owners Jeff Fink and Matt Sieve. The new design direction is described as "moody mid-century maximalism," with a revamped, smaller-plate menu.

data.store_name: Relish Restaurant and Bar (current River Oaks location)

data.short_description: Relish Restaurant and Bar plans to remain at its current River Oaks location on Westheimer Road until the end of the year before vacating the space. Island Grill American Mediterranean will then take over the location.
Relish Restaurant and Bar will move to The RO, a new 17-acre mixed-use development at 3120 Buffalo Speedway. No opening date has been announced, and the development is still under construction.

data.location: 2810 Westheimer Road, Houston, TX (taking over former Relish space)
data.short_description: Island Grill American Mediterranean announced its sixth regional opening on July 21st, taking over the space Relish Restaurant and Bar currently occupies on Westheimer Road. No specific opening date was given.

data.event_date: End of November or early December
data.short_description: Spirulina Health Bar, a Montreal-based wellness brand, is planning its fifth location at DIX30 in Brossard. Co-owner Jessica Power said the team is targeting an opening around late November or early December.

data.location: 140 W Hillcrest Dr, Suite 117, Thousand Oaks, CA 91360
data.short_description: Capris Trattoria Pizzeria, a new Italian-focused concept from owner Nando Silvestri, will replace Marcello Ristorante in Lincoln Oaks Village. It will be Silvestri's third concept under Tutto Bene Restaurant Group and is expected to open in mid-September.

data.status: Targeting a debut by end of November
data.short_description: Casa de Fehu, a European-inspired restaurant from Anatoliy Shalamov and Anastasia De Roy, will debut in Hatboro. The BYOB concept will feature European cuisine, gelato and cappuccinos, and mocktails, with a target debut by the end of November.

Prasino, a Mediterranean-inspired café concept, will open its Wabash Avenue location in Chicago's Loop on August 25. The roughly 3,300-square-foot café will serve breakfast, lunch, coffee, smoothies, and grab-and-go options.

Prasino will open a second West Loop café at Aberdeen Street, planned for approximately 2,000 square feet. This location is set to open later this summer, ahead of a third planned Riverwalk café in 2027.

data.location: 3747 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
data.event_date: This year to early next year
data.short_description: TENSHOU Collection, an upscale Japanese omakase dining concept, plans to open four U.S. locations by end of this year and early next, including one on the Las Vegas Strip. The Las Vegas location is already listed as "coming soon" on the brand's website.

Sisters Alex and Charli Starkman are opening a dessert shop inspired by their grandmother and mother in SoHo. The shop's interior will feature British country chic decor, and the menu centers on a classic British crumble dessert made in-house daily.

Vino and Vinyl Supper Club is expanding into a recently acquired space next door to add a new bar, dining room, and private room. The restaurant will remain open during construction and will also renovate its exterior and patio.

On The Border filed for bankruptcy earlier this year and is now auctioning off equipment, including kitchen equipment and furniture, from former locations in Texas, Oklahoma, North Carolina, Michigan, and Tennessee. TAGeX Brands is handling the liquidation via online auctions.

New owner Rick Doody of NCR Ventures is considering an expansion and upgrade of the historic Old Mohawk restaurant, adding roughly 1,000 square feet including patio space. Conceptual plans have been submitted to the city, which would increase dining capacity by 20-30%.

data.location: 4622 Park Blvd, San Diego, CA 92116, United States
data.status: will officially close/shut down its operations
data.short_description: The Mediterranean restaurant and cocktail bar Madison on Park is closing after over a decade in University Heights. A new dining concept from the same team is planned to open in the space on September 7.
The team behind Madison on Park is also opening a new all-day diner called Dear Josie's in Hillcrest. No further details were given.

data.location: 3145 Northwest Loop 410, San Antonio, TX 78230, USA
data.event_date: construction expected to begin November 20, 2026, completion by October 31, 2027
data.short_description: A new Chinese buffet is planned for a 12,000-square-foot commercial building in Northwest San Antonio, per state project records. Owner Tian Chun Lim confirmed his involvement but did not provide further details on the concept or opening date.

data.location: 405 N Angier Ave NE Suite 220, Atlanta, GA 30308
data.short_description: Sargent, from the team behind Lucian Books & Wine, is opening in Atlanta's Old Fourth Ward with American-inspired, wood-fired dishes. The 6,000-square-foot space includes a full bar, private dining room, patio, and seating for around 165 guests.
Chef Yoshi Okai debuts Kira Omakase, a six-seat omakase experience inside Kira in the Warehouse District. The concept blends Okai's punk-rock spirit with Kyoto culinary traditions.

data.location: 20 Homegrown Way Ste e, Yulee, FL 32097, United States
data.status: will serve its final meal this weekend/permanently closing
data.short_description: Tasty's Fresh Burgers is closing its Wildlight location after seven years, announced by owner Katy Dougherty. The chain's other three locations in Yulee, Fernandina Beach, and Kingsland will remain open.

Baskin-Robbins hosted a grand opening of its new Murfreesboro shop, franchised by Nirav, Ankit, and Binjan Patel. The new 1,300-square-foot shop features sofa-style seating and a mural celebrating local landmarks.

data.location: 407 S Rosemary Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
data.short_description: Fuku, the fried chicken concept from David Chang's Momofuku family, will hold its official grand opening celebration at CityPlace on Aug. 20. The all-day event includes giveaways, a ribbon cutting, and an exclusive dessert collaboration with Aioli.

data.store_name: Boom Bang Fine Foods and Cocktails (2nd location)
data.location: 70 E Bonneville Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89101
data.short_description: Boom Bang Fine Foods & Cocktails is opening a second Las Vegas Valley location at the Las Vegas Civic Center & Plaza downtown, per a city permit. Co-owner Elia Aboumrad confirmed the opening but no exact date has been announced.

Tinto, a Spanish-rooted wine, cocktail, and sake bar, is coming to East 11th Street, per public filings. GM Catie Steele said the opening is pending construction, with a sneak-peek event planned for September 9.

Chef Daniel Boulud is opening a new brasserie-style restaurant on Broadway, featuring favorites from Bar Boulud and Boulud Sud plus new signature dishes. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

Culture, a Greek yogurt shop co-founded by Jenny and Gino Ammirati, is opening a third location in Manhattan's Gramercy neighborhood 15 years after its founding. The new location will have more frozen yogurt machines and its own distinct look.
Westy's closed its Pinch District location after 42 years, citing declining sales, debt, and inflation according to owner Jake Schorr. The building and adjoining synagogue remain for sale.
Sirincci Coffee Company, which has two Slidell locations, is adding a third location in Lacombe, taking over the former White House Coffee and Creamery. The transition began in mid-August.

Oishii, known for its premium Omakase Berry strawberries, is opening its first New York shop as a kiosk in Chelsea Market. The shop will offer gift boxes, preserves, strawberry yuzu lemonade, and pastries made in collaboration with Lady M.

data.location: 2530 Guadalupe St, Austin, TX 78705, United States
data.short_description: 1972 Women's Sports Pub, Texas' first bar dedicated to women's and gender-expansive sports, is closing its Guadalupe St. location. The closure is tied to the property being acquired via eminent domain for the city's Project Connect transit project.

Brooklyn Brewery is closing its 30-year-old Williamsburg location as it moves four blocks away to a new space nearly four times larger. The new location will begin with a soft opening in late summer, followed by a grand opening in fall 2026.

data.location: 2110 NW Military Hwy, San Antonio, TX 78213
data.short_description: Zorba's Greek Mediterranean Grill in Castle Hills closed after 18 years, announced via Facebook on August 14. The restaurant served Greek and Mediterranean dishes including shawarma, tabbouleh, and kebabs, and was founded in 2008 by Ahmad Al-Dmour.

data.status: will begin serving lunch and dinner starting at 11 a.m. daily in the Fall

The 8,233-square-foot restaurant includes a main dining room, bar, private event spaces, wine cellar, and outdoor lounge.

Comfort Foodies opened its Missouri City location during a soft opening, welcoming guests Tuesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. The roughly 3,000-square-foot restaurant offers Latin-Caribbean and Southern Soul Food, seating 50–60 guests.

A second Poké House location is coming to metro Atlanta under local franchise owner Dean Wang, at Barrett Corners Phase III. The brand offers a Hawaiian-inspired menu of poke bowls, sushi rolls, and sides.

Bangers Barbecue, a new concept from chef Andrew "Drew" Bent, is expected to open in the current Bellamy's restaurant space in Escondido. Bellamy's remains open while transition details are worked out.
